newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Fed chief - Fed must be vigilant vs prices.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Fed chief - Fed must be vigilant vs prices.

text.p: Michael Moskow, President of the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, said the U.S. central bank must remain vigilant in its fight against inflation, and cannot allow prices to heat up even a little bit.
"I don't think you can allow inflation to heat up a little bit; you are doing yourself damage because you want to create a low-inflation economy," Moskow told reporters.
"Right now, with a 5.3 (percent) unemployment rate, by most people's calculations, we are at full employment," he added.

As for the cost of labor, the Chicago Fed chief said central bankers are witnessing "an acceleration on the wage side." However, when wages and benefits are taken together, "you don't see that (a noticable increase) in the statistics."
